scientific_integrity: The all-parameter claim is supported by the elementary proof and independent standard-library finite tests. No authorship, absolute publication priority, or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform Hamming graphs, two distinctly individualized vertices; no bound on number of refinement rounds from the initial three-colour partition; finite computational testing supports but does not establish the all-order proof; prior literature coverage is not guaranteed exhaustive.
title: Two-root counting refinement of Hamming graphs: orbit exactness and the sharp metric-pair defect
